description: Ex Israeli AF Shahak c/n CJ-14, used by IAI as a canard-equipped Kfir development prototype before transfer to the FAA 1 February 1983, retired March 1994; displayed on a roundabout painted as Dagger C-437 in memory of 1st Lt Héctor Volponi, shot down 23 May 1982. Photographed 2010 and 2022.
aliases: Mirage IIICJ; Mirage 3CJ; C-437; c/n CJ-14; C437
museum_name: Mirage Rotonda Volponi Monument, Tres Arroyos
